_about: The dev server's answers (usage_monitor/ui/devserver.py, scenario normal, its clock pinned to 2026-10-21 16:12 UTC) as tests/page_words.js serves them to the page: made-up data, trimmed to what the page reads (the themes without their colours, sixty days of history), the state as an installed monitor's. Frozen with the page-words record (#98): never regenerated, so the record stays comparable.
